instruction.name: vexth.q.d
instruction.description: Sign-extend 64-bit elements in the higher half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to 128-bit.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vexth.q.d $vr0, $vr8; vexth.q.d $vr1, $vr9; vexth.q.d $vr2, $vr10; vexth.q.d $vr3, $vr11; vexth.q.d $vr4, $vr12; vexth.q.d $vr5, $vr13; vexth.q.d $vr6, $vr14; vexth.q.d $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vexth.q.d $vr0, $vr8; vexth.q.d $vr1, $vr9; vexth.q.d $vr2, $vr10; vexth.q.d $vr3, $vr11; vexth.q.d $vr4, $vr12; vexth.q.d $vr5, $vr13; vexth.q.d $vr6, $vr14; vexth.q.d $vr7, $vr15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
